note: Actual local runs. Seeded defects are training exercises. Hosted CI has not run.

normal_run.test: catalog search and category apply together
anonymous users cannot read a cart or checkout
wrong password does not create a session
signing out invalidates the session on the server
invalid quantity 0 leaves the cart unchanged
invalid quantity -1 leaves the cart unchanged
invalid quantity 11 leaves the cart unchanged
invalid quantity 1.5 leaves the cart unchanged
invalid quantity "2" leaves the cart unchanged
invalid quantity null leaves the cart unchanged
quantity boundaries and removing items recalculate the total
unknown products and empty carts cannot create orders
cart state is isolated between customers
saved order rows agree with the API and independent arithmetic
invalid JSON returns a client error and the server stays healthy
customer signs in and buys two notebooks
filters can return one item or an empty result
a failed checkout keeps the cart and allows a retry
mobile layout supports adding and removing a product
order total includes every quantity @total
another customer cannot read an order @owner
replaying a checkout does not purchase a later cart @duplicate
